d: INET-IOEX-IRCOM infiNET EX® Wireless IR/RS-232 Control Module

specs.label: RF Transceiver
specs.value: infiNET EX 2-way RF, 2.4 GHz ISM Channels 11-26 (2400 to 2483.5 MHz), default channel 15; IEEE 802.15.4 compliant

specs.label: Range (typical)
specs.value: 150 ft (46 m) indoor, 250 ft (76 m) outdoor, to nearest mesh network device(s); subject to site-specific conditions and individual device capabilities

specs.label: RS-232
specs.value: Supports 2-way device control and monitoring up to 115.2k baud with software handshaking (via the control system)

specs.label: IR
specs.value: Supports 1-way device control via infrared up to 1.2 MHz (via the control system)

specs.label: Power Pack (included)
specs.value: Input: 100-240 Volts AC, 50/60Hz; Output: 1.2 Amps @ 5 Volts DC; Model: PW-0510WUL

specs.label: Construction
specs.value: Plastic, black, (2) integral surface mounting flanges, vented sides
